title: Get a permit for advertising signs in or in view of public places
what: Get the council's permit before putting a sign or poster in a public place, or putting up a sign larger than 0.5 square metres on private premises in view of a public place.

laws.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 24(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) The owner or occupier of private premises must not, without a permit, erect or permit the use of a building, surface or structure over or in view of a public place on those premises for placing or affixing thereon a handbill, poster, placard, sign, advertising or other printed material having an area greater than 0.5m².

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 23(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not place or affix to or within a public place without a permit any handbill, poster, placard, sign, advertising or other printed material.
